thesis: The speaker argues that one should not try to reinvent the wheel but instead clone successful mental models, such as Warren Buffett's use of insurance float. He admits that acquiring Stone Trust was a mistake because he realized he did not want to own and run an insurance company from a board level, so his primary objective became getting investors' capital back to them.
